title: Effort/throughput instrumentation in the outcome ledger
context: Instruments per-dataset effort/throughput in the outcome ledger so the project can show a measurable reduction in median per-dataset effort vs. the M0/M1 baseline. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Code is MIT-licensed; records only effort metrics, never inspected data.
objective: Add effort/throughput instrumentation to the outcome ledger that logs per-dataset effort and reports median reduction vs. baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Outcome ledger records per-dataset effort/throughput metrics in a committed, machine-readable form (no inspected data or secrets).
Reports the median per-dataset effort and the reduction vs. the recorded M0/M1 baseline.
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green with fixtures; DCO signed-off.
